facts.text: Celegia was an Expansion Region world of raging seas.

evidence.quote: Celegia was an Expansion Region world of raging seas.

facts.text: Its atmosphere was rich in the toxic cyanogen gas, and it was the homeworld of the sentient Celegians.

evidence.quote: Its atmosphere was rich in the toxic cyanogen gas, and it was the homeworld of the sentient Celegians.

facts.text: Celegia had become a part of the Galactic Republic by approximately 17,000 BBY and was a member of the Galactic Empire in 17 BBY.

evidence.quote: Celegia had become a part of the Galactic Republic by approximately 17,000 BBY and was a member of the Galactic Empire in 17 BBY.

facts.text: A world of raging seas, Celegia had both land and at least one ocean on its surface.

evidence.quote: A world of raging seas, Celegia had both land and at least one ocean on its surface.

facts.text: Its atmosphere had abundant amounts of cyanogen, a gas that was toxic to most sentient species but which the native Celegians breathed.

evidence.quote: Its atmosphere had abundant amounts of cyanogen, a gas that was toxic to most sentient species but which the native Celegians breathed.

facts.text: Space surrounding Celegia was explored between 20,000 BBY and 15,000 BBY, and the world was a part of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY.

evidence.quote: Space surrounding Celegia was explored between 20,000 BBY and 15,000 BBY, and the world was a part of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY.

facts.text: Around that time, which saw the beginning of a series of conflicts between the planet Alsakan; the Republic's capital world, Coruscant; and their respective allies, Celegia was situated in the Exploitation Region, which was a territory actively controlled by the Grand Companies—Coruscant-af...

evidence.quote: Around that time, which saw the beginning of a series of conflicts between the planet Alsakan; the Republic's capital world, Coruscant; and their respective allies, Celegia was situated in the Exploitation Region, which was a territory actively controlled by the Grand Companies—Coruscant-affil

facts.text: In addition, the hyperspace route connecting Celegia to the Belasco system was under the control of Coruscant.

evidence.quote: In addition, the hyperspace route connecting Celegia to the Belasco system was under the control of Coruscant.

facts.text: During the first campaigns of the Clone Wars of 22 BBY–19 BBY, the Republic's Fourth Sector Army was charged with engaging the military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems in Celegia's vicinity.

evidence.quote: During the first campaigns of the Clone Wars of 22 BBY–19 BBY, the Republic's Fourth Sector Army was charged with engaging the military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems in Celegia's vicinity.

facts.text: The world had become a part of the Galactic Empire by 17 BBY.

evidence.quote: The world had become a part of the Galactic Empire by 17 BBY.

facts.text: As part of their invasion of the galaxy, at some point by 27 ABY, the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong gained control over the Celegia system.

evidence.quote: As part of their invasion of the galaxy, at some point by 27 ABY, the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong gained control over the Celegia system.

facts.text: Evolved from ocean-dwelling invertebrates that eventually adapted to living on land, the Celegians used for locomotion a natural form of levitation that resembled an organic repulsorlift generator.

evidence.quote: Evolved from ocean-dwelling invertebrates that eventually adapted to living on land, the Celegians used for locomotion a natural form of levitation that resembled an organic repulsorlift generator.

facts.text: Around 25 ABY, the population of the Celegia system numbered between ten and one hundred million.

evidence.quote: Around 25 ABY, the population of the Celegia system numbered between ten and one hundred million.

facts.text: Despite that limitation, Celegians eventually established a colony on the Outer Rim Territories moon Tramanos, which also had cyanogen in its atmosphere.
